description: Sensitive text as events.jsonl stores it. Input is the text under a `prompt` key; expected is the value the writer puts in its place, [N chars, sha256:<8 hex>], with N counted in UTF-16 units and the hash over the full text.

cases.name: accented text counts by UTF-16 unit
long prompt is hashed whole
cases.input: The quarterly figures my accountant sent me show a loss of 4,200 euros, and I want to know whether to file.

cases.name: secret-shaped text is hashed, not scrubbed
